en: Gateway: Added a start-up log warning when managed settings name an Amazon Bedrock guardrail in a header, which the gateway doesn't forward, and no `bedrock` upstream sets a `guardrail`
zh: 网关：新增启动日志警告，当托管设置在 header 中指定 Amazon Bedrock guardrail（网关不会转发该 header），且没有 `bedrock` 上游设置 `guardrail` 时触发
